subject: Sales discovery: multilingual model fit & evals (EU/APAC) — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lucie Martin <lucie@globex.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Sales discovery: multilingual model fit & evals (EU/APAC) — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Lucie — great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Recap (top-line):
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference to serve multilingual customer support summarization and routing for Globex Retail across EU (FR/DE/ES) and APAC (JA/KO).
- Success metrics: per-language summary ROUGE/COMET + human accept rate >= 90% on priority locales; latency p95 < 350ms on Dedicated pool for 512-token prompts.
- Data/privacy: production traffic must comply with EU data residency and GDPR; interested in Dedicated or Private deployment options.

Initial model fit recommendations (based on workload characteristics discussed):
- Mistral-instruct-7B (quantized 4-bit) — best cost/latency balance for short summarization prompts.
- Llama-3-13B (v1) — stronger few-shot generation for complex legal/regulatory text (EU legal locale).
- Redwood-llama3-8b-optimized (Redwood-verified variant) — lower-cost baseline for high-throughput routing.

What I'm sending you now:
- Prompt set (attached): prompt_set_multilingual_v1.csv — curated prompts per locale (FR, DE, ES, JA, KO) and evaluation rubrics.
- Benchmark summary (link & attachment): quick per-model per-locale scores and latency/cost estimates — see Drive link below.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm pilot scope: 2-week evaluation across FR/DE/JA with ~1k prompt samples per locale (we can scale).
2) Redwood runs the benchmark on Dedicated (your region preference) and provides a report with per-model latency, cost, and quality metrics.
3) If results look good, we schedule a small in-product pilot and connect your security team for SOC2/RD requirements.

Can you confirm the priority locales and whether the pilot should be EU-only for data residency, or can we run a combined EU+APAC pilot? Also let me know any compliance docs we should send over now.

Thanks — talk soon,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: prompt_set_multilingual_v1.csv (CSV, 42KB)
Attachment: benchmark_summary_20261120.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

From: Lucie Martin <lucie@globex.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: multilingual model fit & evals (EU/APAC) — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few clarifying Qs from our side before we lock the pilot: 

1) Per-locale quality metrics: can you share BLEU/ROUGE/COMET + any human eval pass rates for the recommended models (Mistral-instruct-7B, Llama-3-13B, Redwood-llama3-8b-optimized) on FR/DE/ES and JA/KO? We'd like to see both automatic and small-scale human panel results where available.
2) Cost/latency: can you provide token-level cost and p95 latency estimates for Dedicated (EU region) at 50 qps and 200 qps? We need ballpark numbers to budget the pilot.
3) Data handling: for EU-only pilot, will logs/metrics and any cached prefixes remain in EU? We'll need that for our security folks.

Also, on legal text: some of our summaries are for consumer refunds and regulatory disclosures — do you have prior evaluation notes on hallucination risk for Llama-3-13B vs Mistral for legal-style prompts?

If you can share the benchmark artifacts and a short timeline for the Dedicated run, we can confirm the internal stakeholders and aim for a kick-off next Tue or Wed.

Best,
Lucie
Director, Product Ops | Globex Retail
lucie@globex.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lucie Martin <lucie@globex.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: multilingual model fit & evals (EU/APAC) — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Lucie — answers below and attaching the artifacts. (See quoted original below.)

Quick answers: 
- Benchmarks: Drive folder (link) has the full CSVs and a one-page PDF summary. Top-level observations for your locales:
  - Mistral-instruct-7B: FR/DE/ES avg COMET: 0.78; JA/KO avg COMET: 0.62. Good at concise summaries, fewer hallucinations on short prompts.
  - Llama-3-13B: FR/DE/ES avg COMET: 0.84; JA/KO avg COMET: 0.71. Better on complex legal/regulatory phrasing, at higher compute cost.
  - Redwood-llama3-8b-optimized: FR/DE/ES avg COMET: 0.75; best cost/throughput tradeoff.

- Cost/latency (Dedicated, EU central, 512-token prompts, pilot sizes):
  - Mistral-instruct-7B (4-bit quant): p95 ~ 190ms at 50 qps; ~260ms at 200 qps. Estimated token cost: $0.0025/token equivalent (pilot est).
  - Llama-3-13B: p95 ~ 380ms at 50 qps; ~520ms at 200 qps. Token cost: $0.008/token equivalent.
  - Redwood-llama3-8b-optimized: p95 ~ 220ms at 50 qps; ~320ms at 200 qps. Token cost: $0.003/token equivalent.

- Data handling / residency: For Dedicated we can ensure logs, KV cache, and metrics are stored in your EU project/region. For Private deployments we can run fully customer-managed storage (KMS/HSM). I'll include our SOC2 summary and data flow diagram in the next email to your security contact.

Notes on hallucination/legal risk: Llama-3-13B shows fewer factual omissions on long regulatory sections when combined with our calibrated prompting and a verification reranker; Mistral performs well on shorter customer-provided text but is slightly more prone to omission on long legal paragraphs. We recommend an automated verification step (reranker + rule-based checks) for any regulatory output.

Attachments included: prompt_set_multilingual_v1.csv; benchmark_summary_20261120.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_benchmarks
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54821

Proposed next operational step: Dylan will run a focused EU Dedicated benchmark (FR/DE) tomorrow and surface any regression flags; we'll share a short runbook and result spreadsheet within 48 hours. If that looks good, we'll kick the 2-week pilot with the three models above.

Thanks — I'll loop in Dylan now for the technical run.

Thanks — I'll run the EU Dedicated benchmarks (FR/DE) this afternoon. Plan:
- Automated evals: compute ROUGE, COMET, and token-level perplexity per model per locale.
- Human evaluation: recruit 5 native reviewers per locale for a quick 200-sample pass (accuracy + acceptability).
- Regression detection: we'll baseline current production prompts and run an A/B compare; set alerts in Redwood Console for quality drops >5% on primary metric.

Technical notes for Lucie: please confirm the sample set in prompt_set_multilingual_v1.csv is safe to use (PII-stripped). If there are redlines for legal content, flag those samples and we'll run an isolated verification step.

I'll share the runbook and short CSV with results once the Dedicated job completes (~6-12 hours).
